{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check the result
print("After dropping rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g:")
print("Shape:", penguins_clean.shape)
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:", penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in body_mass_g:", penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print("\nPearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g:", correlation)"}
